The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 6.2.2023 passed in LAC No.127/2022.
This Court,
following the Division Bench ruling in MFA No.102543/2022 dated 23.09.2024, holds that the NC:
2024:KHC-K:9871 limitation period under the Act is mandatory and non- extendable.

However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 172 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. V.R.
Kalliyanikutty, the appeal is dismissed as time- barred, without addressing the merits.
Parties shall bear their respective costs.
